dispute_ticket.description: The driver took a very long way round and the fare jumped from S$19.90 to S$27.40. I did not agree to any route change. Please refund the difference.

chat_logs.content: Why are we on this road?
Traffic on CTE, this is faster.

app_events.details: Telemetry storage fault 14:00-15:30: no GPS points stored for this trip.
Fare S$27.40 charged (fare_recalculated after route change flag set by driver app).

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

route_deviation_fare_adjustment.text: A fare above the upfront quote is justified only if GPS telemetry shows a road closure, an agreed rider request or an unavoidable detour; otherwise the rider pays the quote. If the telemetry needed to decide is missing, a person must decide.

detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl.text: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.

expected_outcome.reason: The fare went from the S$19.90 quote to S$27.40 (a S$7.50 gap), and this trip's policy says the extra can stand only if GPS telemetry shows a closure, an agreed request or an unavoidable detour. gps_telemetry is empty, distance_km and duration_min are null, and app_events at 14:55:00 record gps_ingest_failed (storage fault 14:00-15:30), so the record the decision needs does not exist. The chat (rider 'why are we on this road', driver 'traffic on CTE') is a claim, not proof. The policy says that when the telemetry is missing a person must decide, so this goes to review.
